content_html:
Watched #Kushi : A Good Decent Entertainer which neither gives you any major High nor disappoints either……

After LIGER’s debacle Vijay Devarakonda is back to playing Boy Next Door kind character and he is a treat to watch….After watching this movie I think he should be trying an Out and Out Comedy character at least once and I am sure he will kill it with ease!!!

After a Long Gap Samantha played a role which doesn’t need her stardom to carry and was a typical girl next door kind of char which Samantha donned with ease……

More than the acting power of the lead pair its their fresh pairing and cute chemistry that worked well for the film….First half of the film was decent and passable with the setup and chemistry of the lead pair and its the second half which had the main conflict.

On Paper the concept of Problems faced in new marriages with Atheist vs Orthodox Believers sounds interesting but the execution was not much effective especially when the movie draws a comparison with old Mani Rathnam Classics which dealt with similar Newly Wed couple challenges and also for the standards of the director Shiva whose first two movies were excellent if not classics.

I personally felt that the climax which had a strong point to convey was not properly executed 😞 but overall its a good one time watch movie which you will not regret watching on big screen!!!!
